answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing where nodes cross-examine transaction clusters. Verifiers run topological cut verifications across the interaction graph: if a sparse cut separates suspicious clones from the main cluster, auditors trigger stake slashing. Like a vigilant falcon surveying an isolated tundra, validators inspect each synthetic bridge. Forging valid trust cuts imposes exponential attacker cost.
